name: AppButton
props: text: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, variant: AppButtonVariant = Primary, size: AppButtonSize = Toolbar, icon: ImageVector? = null, shortcut: String? = null, fillMaxWidth = false, enabled = true, busy = false, busyText: String? = null
description: The canonical text/icon button atom with hover/press/focus-ring states, busy spinner and an optional keycap shortcut hint; AppButtonVariant (Primary/Ghost/...) and AppButtonSize (Toolbar/PageCta/...) are public enums in the same file.

name: IconButton
props: icon: ImageVector, onClick: () -> Unit, size: ButtonSizeType, modifier = Modifier, enabled = true, isSelected = false, isLoading = false
description: Square icon-only button with selected and loading states; sizing comes from the public ButtonSizeType enum (ButtonSizeType.kt).

name: Toggle
props: checked: Boolean, onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, thumbContent: @Composable (() -> Unit)? = null, colors: ToggleColors = ToggleDefaults.colors(...theme tokens...), enabled = true, interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
description: Cupertino-style draggable switch (51x31dp) with ToggleColors/ToggleDefaults for theming; use for settings rows that need drag as well as tap.

name: SimpleToggle
props: checked: Boolean, onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, enabled = true
description: Minimal tap-only switch (48x28dp track) with no drag gesture and no colour parameters — the lazy alternative to Toggle.

name: Chip
props: label: String, selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier
description: Single selectable pill chip (28dp high, Theme.cornerToken.chip); use ChipGroup for a row of them.

name: CounterBadge
props: count: Int, state: CounterBadgeState, modifier = Modifier, label: String? = null
description: 20dp numeric badge used for the toolbar staged-annotation counter; CounterBadgeState (incl. Empty) drives container/content colour.

name: GlyphBadge
props: text: String, containerColor: Color, modifier = Modifier
description: 20dp rounded badge rendering a short glyph/number on a caller-supplied fill; the primitive behind annotation index badges.

name: AnnotationMark
props: modifier = Modifier, state: AnnotationState = Pinned, badge: String? = null, sizeLabel: String? = null, showHandles = false
description: Canvas-drawn annotation rectangle (dashed while Drawing, solid when Pinned/Selected/Frozen) with optional index badge, size label and corner handles; AnnotationState is public in the same file.

name: MeasureMark
props: modifier = Modifier, role: MeasureMarkRole = Target
description: Measurement-mode outline in Theme.color.measure, solid for Target and dashed for Neighbour; shipped but currently unwired (measure-mode spec territory).

name: MeasureTag
props: text: String, modifier = Modifier, containerColor: Color = Theme.color.annotate
description: Tiny mono-font pill for dimension/offset labels pinned to an annotation or measurement mark.

name: ErrorGlyph
props: kind: ErrorKind, modifier = Modifier
description: 34dp error mark whose accent follows the public ErrorKind enum (Fixable/...); the icon slot of ErrorCard.

name: StatusIndicator
props: state: StatusIndicatorState, label: String = state.defaultLabel(), modifier = Modifier
description: Dot + label status atom for the status bar; StatusIndicatorState includes Offline/Frozen and supplies a default label per state.

name: StatusPill
props: label: String, tone: StatusPillTone, modifier = Modifier
description: Dot-prefixed pill for list-row status (used by HistoryRow); StatusPillTone picks the dot colour.

name: RadioMark
props: selected: Boolean, modifier = Modifier
description: 18dp Canvas radio indicator (ring + fill) with no click handling — the row owns the gesture.

name: KeyCap
props: text: String, modifier = Modifier
description: Keyboard-key chrome for shortcut hints (e.g. the Cmd+Enter cap inside AppButton).

name: IconContainer
props: modifier = Modifier, icon: ImageVector, backgroundColor: Color, foregroundColor: Color
description: Rounded tinted plate holding one icon; the leading affordance in headers and rows.

name: SafeContainer
props: modifier = Modifier, snackbarHostState: StackedSnakbarHostState = rememberStackedSnackbarHostState(), snackbarHost: @Composable (StackedSnakbarHostState) -> Unit = { StackedSnackbarHost(...) }, content: @Composable (PaddingValues) -> Unit
description: Screen-root scaffold that applies systemBars+ime insets and hosts the stacked snackbar; every feature *Content composable wraps its body in this.

name: MaxSideDetector
props: modifier = Modifier, byHeight: @Composable () -> Unit, byWidth: @Composable () -> Unit
description: Picks one of two layouts depending on whether the container is taller or wider — the cheap portrait/landscape branch without a window-size class.

name: HorizontalAnimatedDivider
props: modifier = Modifier, isVisible: Boolean
description: Hairline divider that fades in/out, used for scroll-dependent header separators.

name: PanelResizeHandle
props: onDelta: (Dp) -> Unit, onDragStarted: () -> Unit, onDragStopped: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier
description: 8dp-hit-area vertical drag handle between the stage and the side panel; reports Dp deltas so clamping/persisting stays in ShellState. Known gap: uses PointerIcon.Hand because commonMain has no E-resize cursor.

name: FilledTextField
props: value: String, onValueChange: (String) -> Unit, placeholder: String, modifier = Modifier, imeAction: ImeAction = Done
description: Plain stateless single-line field — use this when the caller already owns the text state.

name: Input
props: modifier = Modifier, initialText = "", onTextChanged: (String) -> Unit, placeholder = "", textStyle = Theme.typography.body, clearIcon: ImageVector? = null, validationRegex: Regex? = null, keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(Done/Text/no-autocorrect), enabled = true
description: Self-managing single-line input with animated border, optional clear icon and regex validation (error state tints the border).

name: MultilineInput
props: modifier = Modifier, initialText = "", onTextChanged: (String) -> Unit, placeholder = "", textStyle = Theme.typography.body, clearIcon: ImageVector? = null, validationRegex: Regex? = null, minHeight = 120.dp, maxHeight = 240.dp, keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(Default/Text/Sentences), enabled = true
description: Input's growing-height sibling with an internal scroll state between minHeight and maxHeight.

name: AutoSizeText
props: text: String, modifier = Modifier, minFontSize = TextUnit.Unspecified, plus the full Text() parameter set (color/fontSize/fontStyle/fontWeight/fontFamily/letterSpacing/textDecoration/textAlign/lineHeight/softWrap/maxLines/minLines/onTextLayout/style)
description: Text that shrinks its font (and proportional line height) in staged steps until it fits; drop-in for Text where overflow is unacceptable.

name: SectionHeader
props: title: String, modifier = Modifier
description: Plain section title row for settings/form groups.

name: SectionHeaderWithIcon
props: icon: ImageVector, title: String, modifier = Modifier
description: SectionHeader with a leading IconContainer.

name: BentoTile
props: modifier = Modifier, caption: String? = null, value: String? = null, unit: String? = null, variant: BentoTileVariant = Surface, height: BentoTileHeight = S, onClick: (() -> Unit)? = null, content: (@Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)? = null
description: Dashboard stat tile — caption/value/unit shorthand or an arbitrary content slot; BentoTileVariant (Surface/Hero/...) and BentoTileHeight are public enums.

name: SegmentedProgressIndicator
props: progress: Float, modifier = Modifier, activeColor = Theme.color.ink, inactiveColor = Theme.color.line, height = 6.dp
description: Fixed-segment-count progress bar (0f..1f); the same file also exports SegmentedBars(values, highlightIndex, barColor, highlightColor, height) for sparkline-style bar charts.

name: SegmentedBars
props: values: List<Float>, modifier = Modifier, highlightIndex = -1, barColor = Theme.color.ink3, highlightColor = Theme.color.primary, height = 56.dp
description: Canvas bar chart normalised to the max value, with one optionally highlighted bar.

name: WavySlider
props: value: Float, onValueChange: (Float) -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, enabled = true, activeColor/inactiveColor/thumbColor (theme tokens), thumbRadius = 10.dp, waveLength = 20.dp, waveHeight = 6.dp, waveThickness = 4.dp, trackThickness = 4.dp, waveSpeed = 10.dp, onValueChangeFinished: (() -> Unit)? = null
description: Animated wave-track slider; honours Theme.motion.reducedMotion by freezing the wave. Drawing helper is core/draw/WavyPathBuilder.kt (public buildWavyPath + WavyPathDefaults).

name: StackedSnackbarHost
props: hostState: StackedSnakbarHostState, modifier = Modifier
description: Host for the stacked-snackbar system. Create state with rememberStackedSnackbarHostState(maxStack, animation) (StackedSnackbarExt.kt); show with showSnackbar(title, description, actionTitle, action, duration: StackedSnackbarDuration) or showCustomSnackbar(content, duration). This is the error-surfacing path every feature ViewModel's ShowError side effect lands on.

name: PlaceholderProvider / Modifier.placeholder
props: PlaceholderProvider(isLoading = true, content: @Composable () -> Unit); Modifier.placeholder(shape = Theme.cornerToken.nested, color = Theme.color.stage); LocalPlaceholderState: ProvidableCompositionLocal<PlaceholderState>
description: Skeleton-loading system: wrap a subtree in PlaceholderProvider(isLoading) and tag individual nodes with Modifier.placeholder(); used by the *PlaceholderContent composables.

name: Modifier.cascadeIn
props: Modifier.cascadeIn(index: Int)
description: Staggered fade+rise entrance keyed on list index, timed from Theme.motion.durations.tileCascadeMs; the standard way to animate a tile grid in.

name: AnnotationOverlay
props: marks: List<AnnotationOverlayMark>, modifier = Modifier, dimmed = false. AnnotationOverlayMark(bounds: DpRect, state: AnnotationState = Pinned, badge: String? = null, sizeLabel: String? = null, showHandles = false)
description: Frozen-frame treatment: an overlayScrim with clipPath(Difference) cut-outs per mark plus one AnnotationMark each. Takes Dp-space rects only — the kit never does density conversion itself.

name: AnnotationPopover
props: text: String, modifier = Modifier, index: Int? = null, indexColor: Color = Theme.color.annotate
description: Read-only annotation bubble (max 280dp) with an index badge; the gutter/leader-line variant of a staged comment. Use CommentPopover when the text is editable.

name: Ruler
props: totalPx: Int, modifier = Modifier, extentPx: IntRange? = null, majorTickEvery = 500, minorTicksPerMajor = 4
description: 22dp tick strip in device-pixel space, optionally highlighting the dragged extent; the drag guide above/beside the mirror stage.

name: SidebarTabs
props: items: List<SidebarTabItem>, selectedIndex: Int, onSelect: (Int) -> Unit, modifier = Modifier. SidebarTabItem(label: String, count: Int? = null)
description: 26dp segmented tab strip with optional per-tab counts; SidePanelFrame's header is built from this.

name: TabBar
props: items: List<TabBarItem>, selectedIndex: Int, onItemClick: (Int) -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, onItemReselect: (Int) -> Unit = {}, backgroundColor = Theme.color.pop, activeColor = Theme.color.bg, inactiveColor = Theme.color.ink2. TabBarItem(icon: ImageVector, contentDescription: String)
description: Floating icon bottom-bar for the mobile targets, with a distinct reselect callback.

name: SegmentedButtonGroup
props: items: List<String>, selectedIndex: Int, onSelect: (Int) -> Unit, modifier = Modifier
description: 30dp inset segmented control — the shell toolbar's Android|iOS platform switch.

name: ChipGroup
props: items: List<String>, selectedIndex: Int, onSelect: (Int) -> Unit, modifier = Modifier
description: Single-select row of Chip atoms.

name: DeviceChip
props: name: String, state: DeviceChipState, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, detail: String? = null
description: 32dp dot+name chip for the toolbar device indicator; DeviceChipState (incl. None) chooses the dot colour.

name: PlatformToolCard
props: title: String, detail: String, toolState: PlatformToolState, selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, enabled = true
description: 80dp selectable card showing a platform and its detected CLI tool (e.g. "adb 35.0.1 · /opt/homebrew/bin"); PlatformToolState drives the status dot. The PLATFORM row of DevicePickerPanel.

name: CommandBlock
props: command: String, onCopy: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, copyLabel: String = "Copy"
description: Mono code block on Theme.color.codeBg with a copy action; how error cards offer a shell command to run. Machine output stays unlocalised by convention.

name: FormSection
props: label: String, errorMessage: String?, content: @Composable () -> Unit
description: Labelled form field wrapper that renders a validation message under its content slot. Note: no modifier parameter.

name: ActionHeader
props: title: String, actionIcon: ImageVector, onActionClick: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, buttonSize: ButtonSizeType = Small
description: Title plus one trailing IconButton.

name: NavigationHeader
props: title: String, onNavigationClick: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, buttonSize: ButtonSizeType = Medium
description: Leading back/close IconButton plus title.

name: ScreenHeader
props: onBackClick: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, showDivider = false, trailingContent: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null
description: Title-less back bar with an optional divider and trailing slot — the header the detail screens use.

name: SimpleHeader
props: title: String, modifier = Modifier
description: Title-only header, no affordances.

name: LanguageOptionRow
props: label: String, code: String, selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit
description: Language picker row (name + ISO code + selected accent). No modifier parameter.

name: SelectableCard
props: title: String, subtitle: String, selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier
description: Two-line card whose border switches to Theme.color.primary when selected.

name: SelectionRow
props: label: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier
description: Settings navigation row (label + chevron).

name: MirrorFrameView
props: frame: ImageBitmap, deviceName: String, modifier = Modifier, overlay: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit = {}
description: Aspect-correct bezel-less renderer for one mirrored device frame, with a BoxScope overlay slot for annotation marks. The only place device frames are drawn.

name: AnnotationRow
props: index: Int, meta: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, comment: String? = null, finding: String? = null, selected = false, emptyLabel: String = "No comment yet"
description: One staged annotation in the side panel's Notes tab — index badge, comment, coordinate meta, selection state.

name: HierarchyRow
props: nodeId: String, depth: Int, modifier = Modifier, last = false, tag: String? = null, matched: Boolean = false, onClick: () -> Unit = {}
description: 26dp view-tree row with Canvas-drawn indent guides; for a UI-hierarchy / payload tree. matched=true reads at full ink, false at ink3.

name: HistoryRow
props: title: String, meta: String, statusLabel: String, statusTone: StatusPillTone, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, thumbnail: @Composable (() -> Unit)? = null, trailing: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit = {}
description: Capture-history row with 56dp thumbnail slot and a StatusPill; the History tab's intended row (tab content itself is unbuilt).

name: KeyValueRow
props: label: String, value: String, modifier = Modifier, state: KeyValueState = Neutral
description: Label/value metadata row; KeyValueState tints the value (Neutral/...).

name: SourceListRow
props: name: String, selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, serial: String? = null, enabled = true, trailing: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit = {}. Same file: SourceListHeader(text: String, modifier = Modifier)
description: 48dp device row (name + serial + trailing slot) with a disabled-alpha state; the SOURCE list in the device picker and in the error cards' device lists.

name: VerificationRow
props: title: String, delta: String, outcome: VerificationOutcome, modifier = Modifier, outcomeLabel: String = outcome.defaultLabel()
description: Before/after verification row with a signal-coloured outcome accent; shipped for the fix-verification flow, not yet wired.

name: EmulatorSelect
props: avds: List<String>, selected: String?, onSelect: (String) -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, emptyLabel: String = "No AVDs installed"
description: Compact AVD dropdown (28dp, min 150dp) that disables itself on an empty list; the inline emulator picker in NoSignalStage.

name: ErrorState
props: title: String, description: String, modifier = Modifier
description: Minimal centred title+description empty/error block — the lightweight alternative to the full ErrorCard organism.

name: FeedbackBar
props: text: String, modifier = Modifier, status: FeedbackStatus = Success, timing: String? = null, detail: String? = null, actionLabel: String? = null, onAction: () -> Unit = {}, actionVariant: AppButtonVariant = Ghost
description: Inline status banner with a mark, optional timing/detail and one action button; this is the stream-drop / Reconnect banner the error-handling spec overlays on the mirror stage.

name: StatusLine
props: steps: List<StatusStep>, modifier = Modifier, trailing: String? = null. StatusStep(label: String, state: StatusStepState = Pending)
description: 34dp multi-step progress line (dot + label per step) with a trailing text slot; for send/resolve pipelines.

name: AnimationSequenceHost / AnimatedItem
props: AnimationSequenceHost(modifier = Modifier, startByDefault = true, content: @Composable BoxScope.(scope: SequentialAnimationScope) -> Unit); AnimatedItem(modifier = Modifier, index: Int, delayAfterAnimation: Long = default, enter = fadeIn(...), exit = fadeOut(...), content: @Composable () -> Unit)
description: Orchestrates a strictly ordered enter/exit animation sequence over indexed children (nestable, with a public SequentialAnimationScope exposing isAnimating()); used by the splash/onboarding reveal.

name: CommentPopover
props: value: String, onValueChange: (String) -> Unit, onClose: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, index = 1, placeholder: String = "What's wrong here?", meta: String? = null, finding: String? = null, saveHint: String? = null, closeLabel: String = "Close", focusRequester: FocusRequester? = null
description: Editable annotation popover with tail, index badge, meta line and close button — the focused place a tester describes a bug. WAIVED EXCEPTION: deliberately always-dark, the only file in the kit with four hardcoded Color literals (documented carve-out in the drag-annotate verdict), so don't copy its colour style.

name: MeasureCard
props: nodeId: String, specs: List<MeasureSpec>, modifier = Modifier, title: String = "Measuring", index: Int? = null, finding: String? = null. MeasureSpec(label: String, value: String)
description: 360dp spec sheet for measure mode (node id + label/value pairs); shipped by F-1/F-4 but currently has no caller.

name: AppBottomSheet
props: onDismiss: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit
description: Themed ModalBottomSheet wrapper (skipPartiallyExpanded) with an optional title.

name: ConfirmationSheet
props: title: String, body: String, confirmText: String, dismissText: String, onConfirm: () -> Unit, onDismiss: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, isDestructive = false
description: Two-button confirm/dismiss sheet with a destructive variant and press-scale springs; the settings erase-data confirmation.

name: ErrorCard
props: title: String, body: String, modifier = Modifier, kind: ErrorKind = Fixable, command: String? = null, onCopyCommand: () -> Unit = {}, primaryActionLabel: String? = null, onPrimaryAction: () -> Unit = {}, secondaryActionLabel: String? = null, onSecondaryAction: () -> Unit = {}, diagnostic: String? = null
description: 520dp actionable error card composing ErrorGlyph + CommandBlock + up to two AppButtons + a diagnostic line. The single surface for every recoverable failure (adb missing, no device, poll failed) — reuse rather than inventing a new error layout.

name: DevicePickerPanel
props: platforms: List<PickerPlatform>, selectedPlatformId: String?, onPlatformClick: (String) -> Unit, devices: List<PickerDevice>, selectedDeviceId: String?, onDeviceClick: (String) -> Unit, onDeviceAction: (String) -> Unit, onMoveSelection: (Int) -> Unit, onStart: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, plus copy defaults (title/subtitle/platformSectionLabel/sourceSectionLabel/sourceSummary/physicalGroupLabel/emulatorGroupLabel/keyHint/startLabel/closeLabel) and onClose: (() -> Unit)? = null
description: Full-stage 648dp device-picker takeover: PlatformToolCards + grouped SourceListRows + arrow/Enter/Escape keyboard navigation. Data types PickerPlatform, PickerDevice, PickerDeviceGroup and the sealed PickerDeviceTrailing (Detail/Running/Boot) are public in the same file.

name: AppPullToRefreshBox
props: isRefreshing: Boolean, onRefresh: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, content: @Composable () -> Unit
description: Hand-rolled pull-to-refresh via NestedScrollConnection (80dp trigger, 140dp max drag) — no Material pull-refresh dependency.

name: RectifyWindowShell
props: toolbar: @Composable () -> Unit, statusBar: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, state: ShellState = rememberShellState(), sidePanel: (@Composable ColumnScope.(ShellTab) -> Unit)? = null, tabCounts: Map<ShellTab, Int> = emptyMap(), onPanelWidthCommit: (Dp) -> Unit (deliberately NOT defaulted), stage: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit
description: THE top-level app layout and the public contract every desktop feature builds against: Column[ShellToolbar, Row[StageSurface, PanelResizeHandle, SidePanelFrame], ShellStatusBar]. A null sidePanel is the pre-mirror state as a type, not a flag.

name: ShellToolbar
props: platformSwitch: @Composable () -> Unit, deviceIndicator: @Composable () -> Unit, stagedCounter: @Composable () -> Unit, clearAction: @Composable () -> Unit, primaryAction: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, leadingInset: Dp = ShellWindowDefaults.TrafficLightInset
description: 52dp toolbar with five fixed named slots in canonical order plus a reserved leading inset for the macOS traffic lights; the slot order is deliberately not caller-controllable.

name: ShellStatusBar
props: leading: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit, trailing: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit, modifier = Modifier
description: 28dp bottom status strip with leading (tool/session state) and trailing (version) slots.

name: SidePanelFrame
props: activeTab: ShellTab, onTabSelect: (ShellTab) -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, tabCounts: Map<ShellTab, Int> = emptyMap(), content: @Composable ColumnScope.(ShellTab) -> Unit
description: The three-tab (Notes/Payload/History) panel frame built on SidebarTabs, with per-tab content as a slot. Only the Notes tab has real content today.

name: StageSurface
props: modifier = Modifier, content: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit
description: Bezel-less main stage: Theme.color.stage ground plus a Canvas dot-grid texture (16dp pitch, stageDot token) and a required content slot. Everything that renders "in the window" goes in here.

name: ShellState / rememberShellState
props: rememberShellState(initialPanelWidth: Dp = ShellWindowDefaults.PanelDefaultWidth): ShellState. ShellState: activeTab, panelWidth, selectTab(tab), setPanelWidth(width), resizePanelBy(delta), onDragStarted(), onDragStopped(): Dp?, onSessionStarted()
description: Plain Compose state holder for the shell (active tab + panel width) — deliberately NOT Orbit MVI and not a ViewModel, so the shell previews and runs from desktopMain without Koin. onDragStopped() returns a width only when it actually changed, which is what gates persistence.

name: NoSignalStage
props: avds: List<String>, selectedAvd: String?, onSelectAvd: (String) -> Unit, onBoot: () -> Unit, modifier = Modifier, plus copy defaults (noSignalLabel, title, subtitle, stepUsb, stepEmulator, bootLabel, footer)
description: The waiting-for-a-device stage: dashed phone outline, numbered steps, inline EmulatorSelect + Boot, polling footer. Carries a known comp-fidelity waiver (outline ships at 180x380dp vs the comp's ~274x578dp).

name: StyleguideScreen
props: onBack: () -> Unit
description: Live in-app styleguide (~1100 lines) rendering every colour, type role, spacing, corner, stroke and motion token plus most kit components. Reachable via Destination.Styleguide — the fastest way to see what already exists before building anything new.

name: NavigationHost
props: startDestination: Destination? = null
description: The only NavDisplay host; provides LocalAppNavigator/LocalBackAction and owns the entry<Destination.X> branches. Used by the mobile targets; the desktop entry point renders RectifyWindow instead. Never import this from a presentation-feature-* module.

name: AppLocaleProvider
props: languageCode: String, content: @Composable () -> Unit. Same file: LocalLocalization: ProvidableCompositionLocal<String>
description: Overrides the Compose Resources locale for its subtree without recreating the composition (which would destroy the Nav3 back stack); wraps the app root so every stringResource() resolves against the chosen language.

name: MirrorHost
props: viewModel: MirrorViewModel = koinViewModel(), onSideEffect: suspend (MirrorSideEffect, (MirrorIntent) -> Unit) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }, content: @Composable (MirrorUiState, ImageBitmap?, HierarchySnapshotModel, (MirrorIntent) -> Unit) -> Unit
description: Koin/Orbit boundary for the mirror feature. Content lambda is 4-arg: the non-null cached HierarchySnapshotModel is handed in third from MirrorViewModel.frozenHierarchy, so it reaches the panel without entering reduced state. Exactly one call site.

name: MirrorStageContent
props: state: MirrorUiState, frame: ImageBitmap?, onIntent: (MirrorIntent) -> Unit, modifier = Modifier
description: Stateless stage filler that dispatches on MirrorStage to the picker, NoSignalStage, error card or live/frozen annotation stage; goes in RectifyWindowShell's stage slot. Same file exports MirrorStatusLine(state, modifier) for the status-bar leading slot.

name: MirrorNotesTab
props: state: MirrorUiState, onIntent: (MirrorIntent) -> Unit, modifier = Modifier
description: Fills SidePanelFrame's Notes tab with AnnotationRows for the staged annotations; the only side-panel tab with real content.

name: MirrorPayloadTab
props: state: MirrorUiState, frame: ImageBitmap?, hierarchy: HierarchySnapshotModel, onIntent: (MirrorIntent) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier
description: Side-panel Payload tab — previews exactly what Claude receives for the pinned frame; early-returns an empty state when nothing is staged, then renders the editable Prompt block with its token estimate and the 3-column crop grid.

name: HistoryEntryEntity
description: Room @Entity for table history_entry: one sent batch (id, sentAtMs, deviceLabel, prompt, status, thumbPng BLOB, dirPath/framePath/hierarchyPath). Public in source/entity/ because the public HistoryDataSource names it.

name: HistoryAnnotationEntity
description: Room @Entity for table history_annotation: one annotation of a batch. FK to history_entry with CASCADE delete, indexed on batchId.

name: HistoryEntryWithAnnotations
description: Room @Relation projection pairing a history_entry row with its history_annotation children.

name: HistoryEntryDao
description: Internal @Dao: @Transaction parent+children insert returning the rowid, observeAll() ordered sentAtMs DESC, targeted status UPDATE. 7 desktopTest cases incl. cascade delete and re-open-same-file survival.

name: HistoryDataSource
description: Public datasource over HistoryEntryDao, composed from the generic data-database-api base interfaces (no UpsertableDataSource - upsert has no caller).

name: BatchFileStore
description: fun interface disk-write seam (no okio/kotlinx-io in the catalog). java.io desktop impl writes frame.png + crop-N.png under ~/.rectify/history/<batchId>/; Android/iOS stand-ins return null. Never throws. ponytail: unbounded growth, prune-by-age/count is the upgrade path.

name: HistoryEntryMapper
description: Named internal object (deliberately NOT ModelResourceMapper - the write path starts from SentBatchModel and needs the store dirPath, so a toResource inverse would be a never-called fabrication). Never throws; an unknown stored status falls back to Sent.

name: HistoryRepository
description: observe(): bare Flow<List<HistoryEntryModel>>; record(): Unit, throws by contract (the use case wraps it); updateStatus(): the hook F-9 calls and F-8 never does.

name: HistoryFormatting
description: Pure, unit-tested: calendar-day bucketing (Today/Yesterday/Older), meta line, shortBatchId = (id.hashCode() and 0xFFFF).toString(16) (FR-30s literal last-4-hex-chars is unsatisfiable against mintSessionIds decimal format), unionRect/thumbnailRect, inProgressCount, statusTone.

name: ThumbnailBitmap
description: cropAndScale to <=128px longest edge in commonMain (ImageBitmap + Canvas + drawImageRect, FilterQuality.Medium) BEFORE the unchanged CropEncoder - AwtCropEncoder only crops and never scales, so the naive path stored a ~250 KB PNG per row in Orbit state. Gated by a <=128px / <=8 KB test.

name: MirrorHistoryTab
description: The History side-panel tab: grouped LazyColumn(key = id) over the shipped HistoryRow molecule, thumbnail decoded behind remember(entry.id), Verify affordance on Fixed rows only, hairline footer, empty state. Zero new design-system components. Known issue A11Y-8: HistoryRow.onClick is non-nullable so the v1 no-op row still announces Role.Button.

name: BatchFileReader
description: fun interface read seam, the counterpart to the write-only BatchFileStore. java.io desktop impl reads frame.png and hierarchy.xml back out of ~/.rectify/history/<batchId>/; Android/iOS stand-ins return null. Never throws - a file the user deleted is simply null.

name: HistoryRepository.get
description: get(batchId): SentBatchModel? composes the DAO @Relation with BatchFileReader and parses the stored dump into SentBatchModel.hierarchy. Never reads crop-N.png - full-res frame.png plus the stored rects dominates, which also sidesteps the 0-vs-1-based crop index conflict. A batch whose frame.png is gone returns null.

name: RegionDiff
description: Per-pixel Chebyshev distance in RGB over IntArray: changed(p) = max(|dr|,|dg|,|db|) > CHANNEL_NOISE_FLOOR, changedRatio = changed/n. Integer-only, one pass, alpha ignored. Per-channel max rather than luma so a chroma-only fix at equal luma is not missed. Takes IntArray, never ImageBitmap, so it is testable without Skiko.

name: VerifyThresholds
description: CHANNEL_NOISE_FLOOR = 10/255 (absorbs antialiasing, subpixel text, gamma), REGION_CHANGE_RATIO = 0.02f, MIN_REGION_PIXELS = 64. Each KDocd with its ceiling. MET-3s <5% false-positive target is unverifiable in v1 (no golden corpus); tests may only use these to CONSTRUCT an input, never as an expected value.

name: VerifyVerdict
description: Change-evidence verdict, a correction of record against AC-24s literal wording: Fixed iff nodeMatched && afterFinding == null && (regionPx < MIN_REGION_PIXELS || changedRatio > REGION_CHANGE_RATIO). The literal no-material-difference-means-resolved reading would report an agent that did nothing as having fixed the bug. MIN_REGION_PIXELS short-circuits only the pixel conjunct.

name: BeforeAfterFormat
description: Builds the designs result strings (top d6dp -> 0dp; height 24dp -> 32dp . want 48dp) from the existing core/measure primitives deltaLabel/plainValueLabel/displayDelta/SEPARATOR. Branch selection is driven by the BEFORE findings kind.

name: RegionPixels
description: The ONLY file in core/verify that names ImageBitmap, and only as an extension receiver: ImageBitmap.regionPixels(rect) wraps the commonMain readPixels member. Deliberately uncovered by tests - keeping it the single edge is what makes the rest of the diff path unit-testable.

name: VerifyLabels
description: Pure projections behind the verify panel: frame captions, the n-of-m summary, the progress steps and the VerifyError-to-string-key mapping. Kept out of the composable so each is unit-testable.

name: FollowUp
description: Renumbers the still-off rows into 1-based StagedAnnotations for the follow-up re-stage. Pure, so the 0-based-to-1-based conversion is testable without the ViewModel harness.

name: MirrorVerifyStage
description: The Verify stage: two captioned frames side by side with per-annotation rects (neutral in BEFORE, verdict-coloured in AFTER), a Back-to-live chip wired to ExitVerify, a progress strip for the ~2.7s dump, and a 300dp Verification panel of VerificationRows with Send-follow-up and Mark-all-verified. Zero new kit components and zero new colour tokens. Overlay coordinates come from the measured painted box, never the nominal 296x640 (PP-TD-1).

name: VerifyFrames
description: The BEFORE+AFTER bitmap pair, carried on a plain StateFlow and handed to the content lambda as MirrorHosts 5th argument - pixels never enter reduced state (module CLAUDE.md Deviation 2).
